reponse: Daniel Levi owns Fernhill's SAML work end to end [1][3]. The Linear ticket KES-430 is due November 27, an internal deadline with buffer before the contractual go-live [1]. The contract requires SAML SSO live in production by December 1, 2026, with a 10% credit on the Q1 invoice if missed [2]. Work is underway: the ACS endpoint and signature validation were merged [5], staging works against Fernhill's test IdP, but production is blocked on their IdP metadata, expected November 26 at the earliest after their change board [1][6].
